## [1.18.0-dev.1](https://github.com/jordanwoodson/lurk-morphe-patches/compare/v1.17.2...v1.18.0-dev.1) (2026-11-19)

### Kick

#### ✨ New Features

* **Chat search**

### Twitch

#### ✨ New Features

* Autocomplete without ':' can match anywhere and start after 2 or 4 characters
* **Navigation bar position** can hide the Create, Browse and Activity buttons
* **Playlist proxy** URL can be set in Lurk settings
* switches to hide the chat mode pop-up and the extension icons

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Auto-claim channel points** earns points with Disable analytics on
* **Hide Clips** also hides clip shelves on Home
